name: acme-export
description: The Acme lake when no connection is possible: the owner shares a schema export, the definitions are approved from it, and the data-dependent steps wait on a connection. Structured owner persona.
brief_note: IT does not allow any connection to the lake files in this session, so when the agent asks for one, say a connection is not possible and why. You can run one read-only catalog query and share its result: you saved it as shared/lake-schema.csv in the semantic directory. Confirming a figure against your reports waits until the agent can read the data; say so if it asks.
opening: Hi, I am Dana Ruiz, head of analytics at Acme. I would like a semantic layer for our event lake, the source lake. Can you build it with me?
